note: pub fns with no caller outside a test, each with the reason it is unreached. Checked by tools/check-production-callers.mjs. The ratchet only tightens: a name here that gains a production caller fails the check until it is removed, and a new unreached fn fails until it is either wired up or added with a reason. Three of the groups below are answered — the signer, the capture producer and the vendor ABI — and the rest are a baseline somebody has to drain. Never add a name without an argument for it: a list of names with no reasons is the thing this list exists to prevent.

allowed.from_u64: §19 forbids a robot holding a signing key, so `skynet-ed25519` is verification-only and its description says so. The signer exists behind `#[cfg(feature = "test-signing")]` because a test proving the *verified* path needs a signature over bytes it chose, and the alternative is testing the verifier against four fixed messages forever. A dev-dependency cycle back to this package turns the feature on for its own tests without putting it in anything that ships.
allowed.from_seed: As `from_u64` — behind `test-signing`, which nothing that ships may name.
allowed.verifying_key: As `from_u64` — behind `test-signing`, which nothing that ships may name.
allowed.public_hex: As `from_u64` — behind `test-signing`, which nothing that ships may name.
allowed.sign_hex: As `from_u64` — behind `test-signing`, which nothing that ships may name.
allowed.estimated: §47.4's producer side. No capture backend exists on this edition — `skynet-capture` moves handles a V4L2 or GenICam backend would produce and neither is written — so the API a backend calls is unreached by construction rather than by oversight. Phase 1 of DRY-COVERAGE-PLAN.md is what reaches it.
allowed.is_full: As `estimated` — §47.4's producer side, waiting on a capture backend.
allowed.close_gap: As `estimated` — §47.4's producer side, waiting on a capture backend.
allowed.open_gap: As `estimated` — §47.4's producer side, waiting on a capture backend.
allowed.deliver: As `estimated` — §47.4's producer side, waiting on a capture backend.
allowed.revoke_loans: §47.6's frame pool. The loan and the mapping are built and three editions reproduce them; the pixels are not, so the pool a robot offers today is empty and nothing has a loan to revoke. Same unblocker as `estimated`.
allowed.from_flags: The vendor ABI's Rust view (§4, §31.2). This crate is public surface for a driver author outside this workspace, so an in-workspace caller is not expected — and `skynetd-io` deliberately has no edge to it (§33.1), which is why §24's flag values are restated there and held by tools/check-rhal-flags.mjs instead.
allowed.driver_may_activate: §19's driver-activation rule, written twice, with only one copy live. `crates/skynetd-io/src/runtime.rs:519` enforces it inline and is the reached one; this is the spelling nothing calls. Not a safety hole — the rule is enforced — but it is §78's shape exactly, where the remedy for one fact with several spellings is a mechanism rather than care. Folding them is the owner's decision, not this check's. F5 in DRY-COVERAGE-PLAN.md.
allowed.verdict_inputs_all_recorded: §26.4. `skynet-blackbox` can read a sealed window back and replay its cycles through the kernel, and never reports whether the window recorded every field a replay evaluates — so a replay of an incomplete window is presented exactly like a replay of a complete one. F5 in DRY-COVERAGE-PLAN.md.
allowed.transfers: Baseline 2026-09-16 — unreached when this check was introduced, not triaged. See DRY-COVERAGE-PLAN.md Phase 0.2.
allowed.format_pairing_code: Baseline 2026-09-16 — unreached, not triaged. Contract surface mirrored to the Hub, so a consumer outside this workspace may be the only caller; that needs confirming rather than assuming.
allowed.read_path: Baseline 2026-09-16 — unreached, not triaged. §54.2's predicate engine reads a live context, so this is a candidate for the same shape as `driver_may_activate`.
allowed.from_environment: Baseline 2026-09-16 — unreached, not triaged. §25's rendezvous is passed in a unit's environment, so an unreached reader of it is worth a look.
allowed.check_code: Baseline 2026-09-16 — unreached, not triaged. §10's pairing refuses a mistyped code before any network exists, and the reached path may spell that check inline.
